title: useNodeActions returns functions for file/folder CRUD operations including add, rename, copy, move, and duplicate within drives
content:
The `useNodeActions()` hook from `@powerhousedao/reactor-browser` returns an object with drive file/folder operations: `onAddFile(file: File, parent: Node | undefined)` adds a file under a parent folder; `onAddFolder(name, parent)` creates a folder; `onRenameNode(newName, node)` renames; `onCopyNode(src, target)` copies to a target folder; `onMoveNode(src, target)` moves; `onDuplicateNode(src)` duplicates in the current folder; `onAddAndSelectNewFolder(name)` creates and selects a new folder; `onRenameDriveNodes` renames drive nodes (defined `packages/reactor-browser/src/hooks/node-actions.ts:130`, returned at `:157`). That is **eight** functions, not seven. All return Promises. The drive structure uses `Node` (FileNode | FolderNode) hierarchy, queryable via `useNodesInSelectedDrive`, `useFileNodesInSelectedDrive`, `useFolderNodesInSelectedDrive`, and their folder-scoped variants.

_Source-verified 2026-08-13 against Powerhouse source at v6.2.2-dev.45._
